behaviors_asserted: The same code runs on all platforms.
Users expect the code can be run on all platforms with a single command like 'npm deploy [platform]'.
There are many exceptions to the slogan that the same code runs on all platforms.
The documentation does not provide a way to run the exact same code on all supported platforms and lacks a migration guide for moving projects across platforms.
